FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST.title: Setlist
FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST.description:
Each card adds a note.
3 notes = a Song:
[gold]SOLO[/gold]: 3 the same
[gold]BAND[/gold]: 1 of each
[gold]JAM[/gold]: 2 + 1, half a Solo
FLUIDLOVEBAND-GROOVE.title: Groove
FLUIDLOVEBAND-GROOVE.description: +2 to every Song number, per stack. Lasts all combat.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-SONGS.title: Solos
FLUIDLOVEBAND-SONGS.description:
[gold]Lead[/gold]: 10 dmg to ALL
[gold]Rhythm[/gold]: +10 Block
[gold]Keys[/gold]: Draw 2, +1 Energy
[gold]Full Band[/gold]: +1 Groove, 4 dmg ALL, +4 Block
FLUIDLOVEBAND-WORDS.title: Card words
FLUIDLOVEBAND-WORDS.description:
[gold]Opener[/gold]: Setlist was empty
[gold]Finale[/gold]: this card finishes a Song
[gold]Retune[/gold]: change a card's role
[gold]Encore[/gold]: replay your last Song
